notes: v643 - fixes the fix. v642 was meant to let a pending order catch up days you had not opened the app on, and it did nothing, because it only looked for each day's OPEN and LOW. The saved history stores those only for the day it was written; every older day carries just the closing price. So the catch-up walked the right days and skipped every one of them. It now also tests the CLOSE, which is the rule the app has always used elsewhere for a close-only day: a close at or below your limit fills, at the better of the two prices. Also new: every pending order gets a '? why' button. It tells you exactly what the app has seen - how many days of history it holds for that share, the span they cover, the lowest price since you placed the order, and how that compares with your limit. If the price simply has not come to you, it says so; if it should have filled, it says that too. No more guessing from the outside. Load fresh prices and existing pending orders will catch up. Practice money only. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
